summary: v1.4.9 TGC Economy Refresh — full backend + frontend validation. 25/25 pytest backend cases PASS covering APK 1.4.9, wallet ledger (all required TGC keys + 1000 TGC = $10 USDT thresholds), /api/tier/forecast across all 4 tiers (core/flagship/mid/budget) with monthly_forecast_range_tgc + payout_value_usdt=10, /api/node/drip state-aware persistence (engaged_full credits ~8/86400*60, engaged_eco=half, paused_*/idle=0 with reason='no_credit_for_state', elapsed cap 180s, wallet reflects increment), /api/wallet/payout-address (BEP20 valid path, invalid network/short/long address → 400), /api/wallet/withdraw threshold (<1000 TGC → 400 'Minimum withdrawal is 1000 TGC'), /api/devices/heartbeat with new fields incl. node_state='engaged_standby' preserved, /api/admin/mobile-mining/metrics honest split (backend_compute.label, mobile_compute with connected/engaged/engine_active_phones, miners[] include node_state/node_engaged/engine_active), regression on /auth/me, /auth/refresh, /pool/health, /admin/console/snapshot, /devices. Frontend /mobile (worker) validated: all 9 Compute Node testids OK with TGC primary (session-tgc-value='+0.0000 TGC', payout-progress-text='0.05 / 1000 TGC'); all 16 Rewards testids OK (request-payout-btn disabled with text='Payout unlocks at 1000 TGC'); Advanced tab vocab-pure (0 forbidden hits, 'compute_engine_telemetry' present).

issues: Notice text still says 'install the v1.4.8 APK' but APK is now v1.4.9 — minor copy mismatch (spec note flagged this as intended, but worth syncing for v1.4.9 release).

action_items: OPTIONAL: Update Advanced tab fallback notice from 'install the v1.4.8 APK' to v1.4.9 to match shipped APK version.

OPTIONAL: Consider exposing a `tier` override field on POST /api/node/drip so request body tier is respected (currently the endpoint always reads device_tier from user doc and ignores any tier in payload — tests had to call /api/tier/forecast?tier=mid first to persist it). The spec example writes 'tier=mid' on the drip body, implying it should be accepted in-line.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 3078 lines — well above the 700-line guideline; auth/wallet/devices/admin/tier should be split into routers/* modules.

MongoClient instability: during this iteration the backend crashed once with 'Cannot use MongoClient after close' (pymongo.errors.InvalidOperation) and required a supervisor restart to recover login (5xx). Root cause looks like a closed/stale Motor client lingering. Recommend a process-lifetime singleton + lifespan-managed shutdown rather than a module-level client that can be torn down by a hot-reload race.

/api/node/drip ignores `tier` from the request body even though the v1.4.9 spec shows `tier=mid` in the call signature. Either accept tier=Optional[str] or remove it from the spec doc to avoid contract confusion.
TIER_DAILY_TGC / MODE_MULTIPLIER constants and /tier/forecast monthly_forecast_range_tgc are duplicated as hard-coded dicts in three places — consolidate into one source of truth.

/api/wallet/withdraw still takes an arbitrary `address` in body even though /api/wallet/payout-address now stores the canonical wallet — withdraw should prefer the saved payout_wallet_address when present and only fall back to body.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_v149_dev and TEST_v149_metrics_dev devices under worker user via /api/devices/register (idempotent name prefix; not cleaned up).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 25 backend pytest cases green. /api/node/drip persists TGC to user doc and tgc_ledger collection; subsequent /api/wallet calls reflect the increment. /api/tier/forecast PERSISTS device_tier on the user — so order of tier_forecast calls in a test session matters (last call wins). Mocked: per-second on-screen TGC tick on /mobile is cosmetic interpolation between real 30s server drips. Forbidden-vocab purge on Advanced tab confirmed via DOM scrape on viewport 390x844. APK at /api/apk/version returns version=1.4.9, native_lib_embedded=true, size_bytes>=380000. The Advanced tab fallback notice copy still says 'v1.4.8' — main agent may want to bump to v1.4.9 (cosmetic).
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs found. Two early test failures during script bring-up were due to (a) Pydantic field-name mismatch in our payloads (test used 'elapsed' vs server's 'elapsed_seconds'; test missed required heartbeat fields charging/wifi/permission), and (b) /tier/forecast persisting device_tier on user — so absolute drip values depend on the most-recent forecast call. Both were test-script issues, fixed in place. One transient backend 5xx flood was caused by a closed MongoClient instance (pymongo InvalidOperation); a supervisor backend restart cleared it — flagged as a code-review item for the main agent.
